title: CatalogItem

name.description: Name, as the provider's list writes it

serviceCode.description: The kind of request, as a code the provider sets (for example bulky-waste); Open311 service_code

jurisdiction.description: The body responsible, such as a municipality; a Japanese municipality as its 6-digit local government code (with check digit); Open311 jurisdiction_id

provider.description: The organisation that does the work (a municipality, a contractor)

category.description: Category: the provider's section, or a short word such as furniture or appliance

keywords.description: Words to find it by, such as other names

accepted.description: Whether it is taken with this kind of request; for an item that is not, alternative says where to take it

alternative.description: Where to take an item that is not taken (home appliance recycling, the shop that sold it)

sizeNote.description: Size condition, as the provider writes it (for example 幅90cm以下, width 90 cm or less)

serviceDuration.description: Time spent at the place, as an ISO 8601 duration (for example PT5M); the service time of route optimisation

load.description: What it takes of a vehicle's capacity, per dimension the provider sets (for example [volume units, kg]); the amount of route optimisation

skills.description: What the crew needs (for example two-person, carry-out); the skills of route optimisation, matched against a vehicle's or crew's skills

validFrom.description: From when this entry (its fee, for example) applies

validThrough.description: The last day this entry applies

source.description: Where the data comes from (a URL, for example)

description: One item a provider takes requests for, such as one row of a city's list of bulky waste items and fees. Items it does not take can be listed too, with where to take them instead. With a service time, an amount and skills, the values of a request can be computed from its items.
